second_run_narrower: REQUIRES REVIEW: this run's season-clustered interval is NARROWER than the previous one -- 1.00 against 4.00, a ratio of 0.25.

Clustering on the season predicts widening. Narrower is not automatically wrong -- a gate whose variance sat within the season honestly tightens -- but it contradicts the argument the cluster was chosen on, and #169 found five of nine intervals doing this unnoticed. Read it before quoting the interval.
